name: s81hd_glue_r5f
structural_change: R5 (r5f) = r4f + two-layer E face: 5004 of 10008 E-face pins moved M4 -> M6 at the same centre (every 2nd by y), M6 pin-only grant (signal/PG cap stays M5, m6 pin-access stubs). Reason: head-die h10bm GRT overflow (1,215 gcells) sits at the ctl glue E face; M4-only E face = 10,008 pins at 0.192 um pitch. Same RTL/ports/latency (physical only). Prev: R4 (r4f) = r3f + GPL_ROUTABILITY_DRIVEN=0: all four R3 kits (r3m/r3f/r3km/r3kf) were killed in 3_3 GPL (exit 247) after 3h46-5h22 stuck in routability iteration 1 (0.2% std-cell utilisation over 8.4-11.2 mm2, 1.02M instances incl. fixed; congestion is not a placement concern at this fill). Same RTL/pins/outline. Prev: R3 regional glue (STW-S81c-HEAD-GLUE 10-22) after s81hd_glue_m2/f2 FAIL (wire_reach: synthesis merged identical-D frame-header flops of different faces, core 856/999 um from pins;

pin_regs.reason: Source-registered (HD-CTL): every input lands in a pin flop, every output leaves a flop (ot_s81hd_hreg32 / kf / grx pin stages); a recipe pin stage would add unpriced edges.

job.purpose: S81.HEAD ctl glue R3 (frozen interface, relay-pipelined zones) to closure (TT setup / FF hold / DRC 0).

fill_reason.pin_bound: Pin-bound outline = the H10 die ctl reserve 2592 x 4320 (the die plan sized it so every face carries only the links that go that way: E 10008 pins = 2.32/um, W 1.56/um). Std cells (~20k um2 incl. ~48k relay flops) + 4 SRAM leave fill far below 40%: the reserve, not the area, sets the outline; a smaller outline re-creates the H4 star-hub funnel.
